preconditions.description: The number of strings k must be between 1 and 2500.
The length of each string n must be between 2 and 5000.
The total length of all strings combined must not exceed 5000.

postconditions.description: The output must either be '-1' indicating no valid string can be restored, or a string of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(any(s[i] == s_prime[i] for i in range(n)) for s_prime in [s_1, s_2, ..., s_k])
postconditions.description: Each character in the restored string s must match at least one character in each of the given strings s_1, s_2, ..., s_k.

postconditions.expression: any(sum(s[i] != s_prime[i] for i in range(n)) == 2 for s_prime in [s_1, s_2, ..., s_k])
postconditions.description: There must be at least one string among s_1, s_2, ..., s_k that differs from s by exactly two characters.
